name: Photo to Video AI
tagline: Photo to Video AI is a web-based tool that converts static images into natural-motion AI-generated videos in minutes
description: Photo to Video AI is a web-based tool that converts static images into natural-motion AI-generated videos in minutes. Users upload a JPG, PNG, or WEBP photo, write a motion prompt or choose from presets (product showcase, cinematic push, portrait motion, etc.), and receive a 5–10 second video ready for social media or commercial use.
